sections.text:
The type ISM21 relay is an electromechanical over current relay with a variable 
time - lag independent of the current.
It is connected to the current transformers also it can be used to detect short 
circuit in transformers. This procedure details the steps required to completely 
check the proper operation and calibration of the ISM21 relay. It is recommended 
this procedure be carried out on yearly bases

The first draft 
 initiated and tested by eng Nadia Mohamed Abd El Ghany , accepted by general director 
 eng. Fakry Ibraheem Slaam

High 
switching capacity change over contact.
Independed setting of instantaneous tripping at max. current.

sections.text: There are two types of Testing the Relay

items: The first test by isolating the relay from its casing and test it

The second test by injection of the current on the terminals of relay 
 casing which the relay in it's casing

sections.text:
Note 
If you used the first test make sure that CT secondary circuit are shorter at 
the in coming terminal blocks before isolating the relay from it's casing

items:
Look at field maintenance file and compare the setting on the relay with 
 those shown on the setting sheet
Label the wires before removing it from terminal block of the relay
Remove the input current terminals number 1,2 from the relay

Connect the test leads between the current terminals number 1 and 2 on the 
 relay to the current terminals on the tester type (Severker) as shown in the 
 following figure(1)

Switch on the tester press the push bottom (ON)(▼), the red led (ON) light 
 and slowly in crease the injected current to the relay by the current wheel of 
 the tester until the wheel of the current coil of the relay starts to move and 
 the knob indicator of starting current appear

The relay operateswith a pick-up current at the setting value with
 5% increasing or decreasing

Record the value of the pick-up current which 
 appears on the display of the tester in test sheet

Calculate Reset factor: Kres = I 
 res / Iop should be ≥ 
 90%

Slowly decrease the wheel of current 
 injection on tester until the current coil of the relay resets

Record the value of the reset current appear 
 on the display of the tester in tester in test sheet

Slowly decrease the wheel of current 
 injection to zero current then press the push bottom (off)(▼) which the red 
 led (off) light

Inject the current from the tester higher than the setting value by + 10% 
 over the setting so the relay picks up firmly
Keep the injected current and switch off the test set

The number of terminals block of output contact on the relay to trip the 
 circuit breaker are (3),(6) which terminal block (3) take appositive of D.C 
 and the other terminal block (6) go to trip C.B

Measure by a voltmeter the terminal block (3) to ensure that the positive 
 D.C on the relay on this terminal and remove it from its terminal block

Connect the time delayed contact number (3),(6) on the relay to two 
 terminals of the timer on the relay (connect to stop contact unit on the 
 tester)

sections.text:
The stop contact on the tester is a free 
contact i.e.

items:
Be sure that the red led of normally open contact of initiation lighted by 
 pressing the push bottom (▲) and be sure that the red led of normally open 
 contact (free contact) lighted by pressing the push bottom (►) in stop unit

Switch on the tester to inject the current by pressing the push bottom (on 
 + time) to the relay, we observe that the relay picks up and the timer 
 operates and stops after a delayed time setting

The value measured of time delay appears on the display of tester and 
 record it in test sheet as shown as in figure 2
Press the push bottom (off + time) on the tester

Remove the terminals which connected to the timer of the relay and connect 
 again the positive terminal to terminal block (3)
Request the operator to switch on the main circuit breaker

Switch on the tester and inject the current so the relay picks up and 
 after a certain time delay, the out put contact on the relay closes makes the 
 circuit breaker trip

Be sure that another out put contact on the relay (9),(10) terminal blocks 
 is closed makes a signal alarm

Slowly decreases the injected current and press the push bottom (off) and 
 switch off the tester

Compare the measured values of current and time recorded in test sheet by 
 the setting values recorded also in test sheet to ensure that the response of 
 the relay is correct after we obtain the reset factor calculated 
 Reset value current
 Reset factor % = --------------------------- x 100
 Pick up current value

Repeat the above current test, time test and trip test for other units of 
 phases
